playability: at least one reward and 1 <= targetScore <= totalScore; zero rewards or insufficient total is a savable draft, not a playable level
noGuard: no chase/caught; retained global guard parameters inactive; timer unchanged
ai: manual add/copy/delete only; AI reads counts, explains and locates object panel; no new write operations
placement: preview first, explicit legal coordinate commit; no silent nearest-point relocation
identity: new ID per add/copy, monotonic project allocator; undo restores same ID; allocator never rewinds
limitsEvidence: review defaults, not performance or teaching evidence
